name: codex-pdf-previewer
description: Open attached and local PDFs in Codex with high-resolution rendering.

interface.shortDescription: Sharper local PDF previews for Codex
interface.longDescription: High-resolution PDF previews inside Codex. Open attached or local files, scroll continuously and copy text. Runs locally on macOS, Windows and Linux with Python 3.10+.
defaultPrompt: Open the attached or selected PDF inside Codex.
